meta.description: Use when asked to implement, build, fix, or create features - especially before writing any code or when scope and requirements are unclear

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在写代码前需要理清需求和范围
copy.fit_line_en: For you if need to clarify requirements and scope before coding

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 不会直接写代码或实现功能，而是会先做规划：它会提问澄清需求、研究代码库、分析风险，然后生成一份详细的书面工作计划。
howto.when: 当你要求实现、构建、修复或创建功能时触发，特别是在写任何代码之前，或者当任务的范围和需求不明确的时候。

say.text: 帮我规划这个新功能的实现步骤
say.note: 它会开始提问并最终输出一个计划文件

say.text: 分析一下这个bug的修复方案
say.note: 它会生成一个计划，列出修复步骤和测试方法

say.text: 为项目添加缓存功能，先做个规划
say.note: 它会进行需求访谈并制定详细工作计划

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude will not write code or implement features directly. Instead, it will first create a plan: it asks clarifying questions, researches the codebase, analyzes risks, and generates a detailed written work plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement, build, fix, or create features, especially before writing any code or when scope and requirements are unclear.

say_en.text: Plan the steps to implement this new feature.
say_en.note: It will start asking questions and eventually output a plan file.

say_en.text: Analyze the fix for this bug.
say_en.note: It will generate a plan with fix steps and testing methods.

say_en.text: Plan the addition of caching to the project.
say_en.note: It will conduct a requirements interview and create a detailed work plan.
